purpose: Estimate the probability that the next BTCUSDT perpetual five-minute bar closes above its open; this is a directional proxy for a binary BTC five-minute event and is not a Polymarket execution validation.

source.price_data: Official Binance public futures monthly BTCUSDT 5m klines

event.label: 1 when close > open, 0 when close < open
event.availability: price features use only completed bars before the decision; derivatives metrics use create_time <= decision_time minus five minutes
event.gaps: rows without twelve consecutive prior five-minute transitions are excluded

model.calibration: Platt logistic calibration fitted on the separate calibration partition

interpretation.probability_claim: A calibrated model probability is meaningful only if predictions in a probability bucket resolve at approximately that frequency on unseen data.
not_claimed: an executable edge after prediction-market fees
